body.title: ER page builder
body.summary: In er.ts add a pure builder from ErDefinition to CompanionPageContent: Mermaid erDiagram with typed scalar columns, PK markers from identifier slots, relationship lines labelled with the slot name and cardinality (||--o{ multivalued, ||--|| required single, ||--o| optional single, self-loops), sanitised identifiers/labels; an entities table (entity, description, key, relationships) and one columns table per entity (column, type, required, multi-valued, PK/FK, description).
acceptanceChecks: Source starts with erDiagram, never classDiagram.
Cardinality, self-loop and PK rendering match the LLD edge cases.
Missing descriptions become null cells; an attribute-less entity gets a 'no columns' row.
Entity/slot names with quotes, angle brackets, colons or non-ASCII produce sanitised erDiagram source and escaped table cells.

tests.name: er page builder: erDiagram, PK, cardinality, self-loop (Delivery read-model fixture)
er page builder: entities + columns tables, null descriptions, no-columns row
er page builder: hostile characters sanitised
